questions.question: An item is sold at 25% discount. If the marked price is Rs. 800, what is the selling price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 800

Discount = 25%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount ÷ 100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Selling Price = 800 × (1 - 25 ÷ 100)

⇒ Selling Price = 800 × (1 - 0.25)

⇒ Selling Price = 800 × 0.75

⇒ Selling Price = Rs. 600

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 600.**

questions.question: What is the discount amount on a Rs. 1,200 item sold at 15% discount?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price = Rs. 1200

Discount Percentage = 15%

**Formula Used:**

Discount Amount = (Marked Price × Discount Percentage) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount Amount = (1200 × 15) ÷ 100

⇒ Discount Amount = 18000 ÷ 100

⇒ Discount Amount = Rs. 180

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 180.**

questions.question: In a construction plan, a parallelogram-shaped metal plate has sides (3x - 2) cm and (x + 4) cm. If the perimeter is 48 cm, find x.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sides of the parallelogram = (3x - 2) cm and (x + 4) cm

Perimeter = 48 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of a parallelogram = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 48 = 2 × [(3x - 2) + (x + 4)]

⇒ 48 = 2 × (3x - 2 + x + 4)

⇒ 48 = 2 × (4x + 2)

⇒ 48 / 2 = 4x + 2

⇒ 24 = 4x + 2

⇒ 24 - 2 = 4x

⇒ 22 = 4x

⇒ x = 22 / 4

⇒ x = 5.5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.5.**

Now, use the **Pythagoras Theorem** to find **slant height (l)**: l = √(h² + r²). l = √(18² + 3.5²) = √(324 + 12.25) = √336.25 ≈ 18.3 cm. **∴ The correct answer is 18.3 cm.**

questions.question: A bridge has parallelogram-shaped metal supports where adjacent angles are in a 5 : 4 ratio. What is the measure of the larger angle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Adjacent angles ratio = 5 : 4

**Formula used:**

In parallelogram, adjacent angles sum = 180°

**Calculations:**

Let angles = 5x and 4x

⇒ 5x + 4x = 180

⇒ 9x = 180

⇒ x = 20

⇒ Larger angle = 5x = 5 × 20 = 100°

**∴ Larger angle = 100°**

questions.question: A pavement is tiled in the shape of a triangle with area 84 cm2 and a semi-perimeter of 21 cm. What is the radius of the circle that fits perfectly inside the triangle (inradius)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of triangle = 84 cm²

Semi-perimeter = 21 cm

**Formula Used:**

Inradius = Area / Semi-perimeter

**Calculation:**

⇒ Inradius = 84 / 21

⇒ Inradius = 4 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4 cm.**

questions.question: Find the volume of a pyramid whose base is an equilateral triangle having each side of length 12 cm, and a height of the pyramid 8 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Side of equilateral triangle = 12 cm

Height of the pyramid = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of pyramid = (1/3) × Base Area × Height

Base Area of equilateral triangle = (√3/4) × side²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Base Area = (√3/4) × 12 × 12

⇒ Base Area = (√3/4) × 144

⇒ Base Area = 36√3 cm²

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 36√3 × 8

⇒ Volume = 96√3 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 96√3 cm³.**

questions.question: By selling 15 articles, a man gains the selling price of 3 articles. Find the profit percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

By selling 15 articles, gain = SP of 3 articles

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit ÷ Cost Price) × 100

**Calculations:**

Let SP of 1 article = 1 unit

⇒ SP of 15 articles = 15

⇒ Gain = SP of 3 articles = 3

⇒ Total CP of 15 articles = SP − Gain = 15 − 3 = 12

⇒ CP of 1 article = 12 ÷ 15 = 0.8

⇒ Profit per article = 1 − 0.8 = 0.2

⇒ Profit % = (0.2 ÷ 0.8) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 25%

**∴ Profit = 25%**

questions.question: The compound interest on a certain sum at 20% p.a. for 2½ years, compounded yearly, is ₹ 2920. Find the principal.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective **Rate of Interest** for the first 2 years = 20 + 20 + (20 × 20)/100 = 44%.

Effective Rate for the remaining 1/2 year = 10%.

Total Effective Rate = 44 + 10 + (44 × 10)/100 = 58.4%.

**Principal** (P) = **Compound Interest** / 58.4% = 2920 / 0.584 = ₹5,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate (R) = 20% p.a., Time (n) = 2.5 years, Compound Interest (CI) = ₹2,920.

**Formula:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ¹ × (1 + (R × f)/100), where n1 is the complete years and f is the fraction of the year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/415d22447e19477b70949c056387601df214d50e379883a2ff0d553e480b1b43.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total **Time** = 2 years + 1/2 year

⇒ Rate for the fractional part = 20% × (1/2) = 10%

⇒ Amount (A) = P × (1 + 20/100) × (1 + 20/100) × (1 + 10/100)

⇒ A = P × (6/5) × (6/5) × (11/10)

⇒ A = P × (396 / 250)

⇒ **Interest** (CI) = A − P = P(396/250 − 1) = P(146 / 250)

⇒ 2920 = P × (146 / 250)

⇒ P = (2920 × 250) / 146

⇒ P = 20 × 250 = ₹5,000

⇒ The **Principal** is ₹5,000, which corresponds to Option (3).

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for Fractional Time

When time is in fractions like t = n (a/b) years, use the rate R for n years and (a/b)×R for the remaining fraction of the year.

Successive Percentage Formula

For two successive changes of x% and y%, the net effective change is (x + y + (x × y)/100)%.

Compound Interest vs Simple Interest

The difference between CI and SI for 2 years is P(R/100)² and for 3 years is P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

questions.question: The least number which is divisible by each of the numbers 14, 21, and 28 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers = 14, 21, 28

**Formula used:**

Least number divisible by given numbers = LCM

**Calculations:**

14 = 2 × 7

21 = 3 × 7

28 = 2² × 7

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3 × 7

⇒ LCM = 4 × 3 × 7

⇒ LCM = 84

**∴ Least number = 84**

questions.question: In a college, there are 600 faculty members, out of which 40% are females. The average height of males is 170 cm, and the average height of females is 160 cm. What is the average height of the entire faculty?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **males** to **females** = 60% : 40% = 3 : 2.

Using **Weighted Average**: [(3 × 170) + (2 × 160)] ÷ (3 + 2)

⇒ (510 + 320) ÷ 5 = 830 ÷ 5 = 166 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 166 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total **faculty members** = 600

Percentage of **females** = 40%

Average height of **males** = 170 cm

Average height of **females** = 160 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bea7d34331942f3a4257fcce889bc5a767ec5d45ce3361e3cbf44d6ff9f6f1b2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of **females** = 40% of 600 = (40 ÷ 100) × 600 = 240

⇒ Number of **males** = 600 − 240 = 360

⇒ Total height of **males** = 360 × 170 = 61200 cm

⇒ Total height of **females** = 240 × 160 = 38400 cm

⇒ Total height of all **faculty members** = 61200 + 38400 = 99600 cm

⇒ **Average height** = 99600 ÷ 600

⇒ **Average height** = 166 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 166 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

The weighted average is calculated as (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n represents the quantity and x represents the average value.

Deviation Method

Assume a base average (e.g., 160), calculate deviations for each group, and adjust: 160 + [60% × (170 − 160)] = 160 + 6 = 166 cm.

Ratio Property in Averages

When calculating combined averages, the actual numbers can be replaced by their simplest ratios to simplify the arithmetic.</p

questions.question: Two buses start from two different cities that are 300 km apart and travel towards each other. The first bus's speed is 50 km/h, and the second bus's speed is 70 km/h. What is the time taken for them to meet?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between the two cities = 300 km

Speed of the first bus = 50 km/h

Speed of the second bus = 70 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time taken to meet = Distance ÷ (Speed of first bus + Speed of second bus)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total speed = Speed of first bus + Speed of second bus

⇒ Total speed = 50 + 70

⇒ Total speed = 120 km/h

⇒ Time taken = Distance ÷ Total speed

⇒ Time taken = 300 ÷ 120

⇒ Time taken = 2.5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 2.5 hours.**

questions.question: Three friends start a mobile app company. Arjun invests 1,20,000, Beena invests 90,000, and Charu invests 1,50,000. After one year, they earn a profit of 72,000. What will Beena's share of the profit be?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Arjun's investment = 1,20,000

Beena's investment = 90,000

Charu's investment = 1,50,000

Total profit = 72,000

**Formula Used:**

Profit share = (Individual investment ÷ Total investment) × Total profit

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total investment = 1,20,000 + 90,000 + 1,50,000

⇒ Total investment = 3,60,000

⇒ Beena's profit share = (90,000 ÷ 3,60,000) × 72,000

⇒ Beena's profit share = (1 ÷ 4) × 72,000

⇒ Beena's profit share = 18,000

**∴ The correct answer is 18,000.**

questions.question: Two circles with radii 8 cm and 2 cm are separated by a distance of 13 cm between their centers. From the center of the smaller circle, a tangent is drawn to the larger circle. What is the length of this tangent segment?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of larger circle (R) = 8 cm

Radius of smaller circle (r) = 2 cm

Distance between centers = 13 cm

**Formula used:**

Length of tangent from external point = √(d² − R²)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Length = √(13² − 8²)

⇒ = √(169 − 64)

⇒ = √105

**∴ Length of tangent = √105 cm**

questions.question: Sum of A and B is 100 percent more than the sum of C and D. C is 20 percent more than D. If A is 200 percent more than B and D = 500, then what is the value of A?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**D = 500**; **C** is 20% more ⇒ **C = 600**.

Sum **(C + D) = 1100**.

Sum **(A + B)** is 100% more than 1100 ⇒ **A + B = 2200**.

**A** is 200% more than **B** ⇒ **A : B = 3 : 1**.

**A** = (3/4) × 2200 = 1650.

**∴ The correct answer is 1650.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **D = 500**, **C** = 120% of **D**, **A + B** = 200% of **(C + D)**, **A** = 300% of **B**.

**Formula:** Value increased by x% = Base × (100 + x)/100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f220f562d1bfec3eb91896cf24842b69e9fc58d26b651b514f5d5f4066499b42.png] 

⇒ **C** = 500 + 20% of 500 = 500 + 100 = 600

⇒ **C + D** = 600 + 500 = 1100

⇒ **A + B** = 1100 + 100% of 1100 = 1100 + 1100 = 2200

⇒ **A** = **B** + 200% of **B** = 3**B**

⇒ 3**B** + **B** = 2200 ⇒ 4**B** = 2200

⇒ **B** = 550

⇒ **A** = 3 × 550 = 1650

**∴ The correct answer is 1650.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage Increase vs Percentage Of

x% **more than** y means y × (1 + x/100), whereas x% **of** y means y × (x/100).

Ratio and Sums

If a sum S is divided in the ratio **a:b**, the parts are [a/(a+b)] × S and [b/(a+b)] × S.

Multiplication Factor

For a **100% increase**, the factor is 2. For a **200% increase**, the factor is 3.</p

questions.question: The amount received on a certain sum at the same annual rate of interest after 3 years and 5 years on compound interest (compounding annually) is Rs. 5324 and Rs. 6442.04 respectively. What is that sum?
The difference between simple interest on a certain sum at the annual rate of 12 percent for 4 years and 7 years is Rs. 72. What is the sum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest = 12% per annum

Difference in time = 7 years - 4 years = 3 years

Difference in simple interest = Rs. 72

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Difference in SI = (Principal × Rate × Difference in Time) ÷ 100

⇒ 72 = (Principal × 12 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 72 = (Principal × 36) ÷ 100

⇒ Principal = (72 × 100) ÷ 36

⇒ Principal = 7200 ÷ 36

⇒ Principal = 200

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 200.**

questions.question: Selling price of an article is 120 percent more than the value of discount. Selling price is what percent of the marked price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) = 120% more than the value of the discount

Marked price (MP) = SP + Discount

**Formula Used:**

SP ÷ MP × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the discount = x

⇒ SP = x + 120% of x = x + (120 ÷ 100) × x = x + 1.2x = 2.2x

⇒ MP = SP + Discount = 2.2x + x = 3.2x

⇒ SP ÷ MP × 100 = (2.2x ÷ 3.2x) × 100

⇒ (2.2 ÷ 3.2) × 100

⇒ 68.75%

**∴ The correct answer is 68.75 percent.**

questions.question: P and Q together can complete a work in 24 days. They started the work together but after 8 days P left the work. Remaining work is completed by Q in 20 more days. P alone can complete this entire work in how many days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P + Q = 24 days

Worked together = 8 days

Remaining work done by Q = 20 days

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

LCM of 24 and 20 = 120

⇒ Total work = 120 units

⇒ (P + Q) 1 day work = 120 ÷ 24 = 5 units

⇒ Work done in 8 days = 5 × 8 = 40 units

⇒ Remaining work = 120 − 40 = 80 units

⇒ Q completes 80 units in 20 days

⇒ Q’s 1 day work = 80 ÷ 20 = 4 units

⇒ (P + Q) = 5 units

⇒ P = 5 − 4 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Time taken by P alone = 120 ÷ 1 = 120 days

**∴ P alone can complete the work in 120 days**

questions.question: P and Q working alone can complete a work in 12 days and 24 days respectively. They work on alternate days one at a time. P works on the first day. In how many days the whole work will be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P = 12 days

Q = 24 days

Work alternately, P starts first

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

LCM of 12 and 24 = 24

⇒ Total work = 24 units

⇒ P’s 1 day work = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 units

⇒ Q’s 1 day work = 24 ÷ 24 = 1 unit

⇒ In 2 days (P + Q): 2 + 1 = 3 units

⇒ In 16 days (8 cycles): 3 × 8 = 24 units

**∴ Work will be completed in 16 days**
